name: CRM and Sales
description: Customer relationship management, lead generation, sales pipeline tracking, and contact management systems.
agent_relevance: High. Agents automate lead enrichment, deal updates, customer meeting logging, and outreach sequencing.
typical_auth: OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Flow) for multi-tenant integrations; API Keys for single-workspace custom apps.
common_blockers: Custom field schema discovery, strict API call limits per seat, and enterprise permissions.

name: Project Management
description: Task management, issue tracking, sprint planning, and roadmap visualization platforms.
agent_relevance: Critical. Agents manage backlog grooming, create subtasks, assign tickets, and report project status.
typical_auth: OAuth 2.0 and Personal Access Tokens (PAT); workspace-scoped granular tokens.
common_blockers: Complex multi-tenant workspace routing, webhooks verification, and custom status workflows.

name: Communication and Collaboration
description: Real-time messaging, telephony, video conferencing, and team collaboration platforms.
agent_relevance: Critical. Serves as the primary conversational interface (chatbots) and alert dispatch channel for autonomous agents.
typical_auth: OAuth 2.0 Bot Tokens, Bearer Tokens, and API Key / Account SID pairs.
common_blockers: Socket Mode vs HTTP webhook URL verification, bot permission scopes, rate limits on message broadcasting.

name: Marketing Automation
description: Email campaigns, customer lifecycle messaging, audience segmentation, and deliverability platforms.
agent_relevance: High. Agents draft emails, trigger subscriber journeys, analyze engagement metrics, and tag contacts.
typical_auth: API Keys and OAuth 2.0; domain verification DNS records for sending tools.
common_blockers: Compliance/anti-spam gating, list double-opt-in rules, bulk payload rate caps.

name: Customer Support
description: Help desks, ticketing systems, conversational support widgets, and knowledge base portals.
agent_relevance: Critical. Direct operational domain for autonomous triage, automated replies, sentiment analysis, and escalation.
typical_auth: OAuth 2.0 and Basic Auth (Token/email), Scoped API Keys.
common_blockers: Agent seat license attribution (making API calls on behalf of an agent vs a human seat).

name: Finance and Accounting
description: Payment gateways, general ledger accounting, invoicing, subscription billing, and expense management.
agent_relevance: High value, high risk. Agents automate reconciliation, invoice creation, and payment collection tracking.
typical_auth: Restricted Secret API Keys with IP whitelisting; OAuth 2.0 for multi-tenant accounting platforms.
common_blockers: Strict compliance (PCI-DSS/SOX), partner program hurdles for accounting software (e.g. QuickBooks/NetSuite), sandbox requirements.

name: HR and Recruitment
description: Applicant tracking systems (ATS), human resource information systems (HRIS), and global payroll platforms.
agent_relevance: High. Agents parse candidate profiles, coordinate interview scheduling, and update employee onboarding.
typical_auth: API Keys, OAuth 2.0, and Enterprise Client Credentials; often partner-gated.
common_blockers: Enterprise tier lock-in, vendor marketplace certification hurdles, strict PII privacy constraints.

name: Developer Tools
description: Source code management, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, error monitoring, and feature flag management.
agent_relevance: Core ecosystem. Developer agents open PRs, monitor logs, deploy builds, and triage errors.
typical_auth: Fine-grained Personal Access Tokens, GitHub Apps (private key + installation token), Scoped API Tokens.
common_blockers: Branch protection rules, organization-level SSO enforcement, and short token lifespans.

name: Analytics and Business Intelligence
description: Product analytics, customer data platforms (CDP), SQL dashboards, and event streaming pipelines.
agent_relevance: Medium-High. Agents run ad-hoc queries, extract business KPIs, and synchronize tracking events.
typical_auth: Project Write Keys for ingestion, OAuth 2.0 or Service Account Keys for querying data.
common_blockers: Query compute costs, asynchronous export jobs for large query results, rate limits on bulk export.

name: Storage and Document Management
description: Cloud object/file storage, collaborative documents, electronic signatures, and relational databases.
agent_relevance: Critical. Agents read reference documentation, generate reports, store artifacts, and request signatures.
typical_auth: OAuth 2.0 with refresh tokens, Internal Integration Tokens (Notion/Coda), Service Accounts.
common_blockers: File size limits for uploads/downloads, block-level nested document structures, permission inheritance.
